items.title: New Zealand Parliament Passes Trade Deal with India to Cut Tariffs

items.title: U.S. House Advances Russia Sanctions Bill Proposing 100% Tariffs on India

items.title: Indian Army Chief Dhiraj Seth Visits Russia to Deepen Defence Ties

items.title: India's Goods Exports Surge by 26% to Reduce Trade Deficit

items.title: Two New Frog Species Discovered in Mizoram

items.title: 46th Chess Olympiad Commences in Samarkand

items.title: Dhiraj Wins Archery World Championship Final Gold Title

items.title: Sree Charani Breaks Record for Highest ICC Rating Points by an Indian

items.summary: HAL Airport has become the first airport in India to operationalise the RNP CAT H helicopter approach procedure. The system uses a satellite-guided precision navigation system engineered specifically for helicopter operations.

items.summary: Elena Rybakina won the US Open title by defeating the top seed and two-time defending champion in the final. Following her victory, she ascended to the World No. 1 ranking in women's tennis.

items.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹24,815 Crore Multi-Tracking Railway Projects in U.P. and Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved multi-tracking railway projects worth ₹24,815 crore across 15 districts in Uttar Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh. The project will expand the Indian Railways network by about 601 km and includes the ₹14,926 crore Ghaziabad-Sitapur line to enhance connectivity between northern and eastern India.

items.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹9,889 Crore Railway Line Projects in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has sanctioned new railway lines in Andhra Pradesh valued at ₹9,889 crore, featuring 198-km-long third and fourth lines between Rajahmundry and Visakhapatnam. The expansion aims to enhance port connectivity, boost tourism, and handle an additional freight traffic of 29.04 million tonnes per annum.

items.title: MHA Designates Shahzad Bhatti Network as Terrorist Organisation Under UAPA
items.summary: The Union Ministry of Home Affairs has designated the Shahzad Bhatti Network as a terrorist organisation under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act. The ministry notified that the group's activities pose a serious threat to national security, communal harmony, and the democratic system.

items.title: West Bengal Joins Union Government's PM Vishwakarma Scheme
items.summary: West Bengal has for the first time joined and launched the Union government's PM Vishwakarma Scheme. The state government also observed the launch event as Annapurna Divas.

items.title: PM Modi Addresses Semicon India 2026 on Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed Semicon India 2026, positioning India as a trustworthy destination for chipmaking amid concerns over supply chain weaponisation. He stressed that India's emergence as an electronics manufacturing hub will benefit the global economy.

items.title: New Cat Species 'Tilcayo' Identified in Bolivia
items.summary: A new cat species named 'Tilcayo' has been identified in Bolivia, marking the first such discovery in over a century. Genetic analysis indicates that the lineage separated from other tiger cats approximately 1.4 million years ago.

items.title: Moody's Raises India's FY27 GDP Growth Forecast to 7%
items.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7%, citing resilience despite geopolitical tensions in West Asia. The rating agency noted that elevated energy prices and El Niño-related food price pressures remain risks to inflation and growth.

items.title: Government Launches 16th Round of Commercial Auctions for 25 Coal Blocks
items.summary: The Government of India has put 25 coal blocks up for sale under the 16th round of commercial auctions. The offered mines are distributed across nine states, including Arunachal Pradesh, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, and Jharkhand.

items.title: Abhishek Sharma Scores Fastest T20 Century by an Indian
items.summary: Abhishek Sharma scored a 34-ball century against Afghanistan, setting the record for the fastest hundred by an Indian in full-member T20 matches. He broke the previous national record of a 35-ball century set by Rohit Sharma in 2017.

items.title: GRSE Launches Indigenous Ocean Research Vessel 'Sagar Manthan'
items.summary: Kolkata-based Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) has launched 'Sagar Manthan', an indigenously built ocean research vessel. The ₹840-crore vessel is expected to be ready for operational use by early 2028.

items.summary: Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) members questioned the Centre regarding foreign funds and asset takeover provisions in proposed FCRA amendments. The Home Ministry defended the changes as steps to enhance transparency and accountability.

items.title: Supreme Court Petition Filed Against ECI Freeze on Party Symbol
items.summary: A petition was filed in the Supreme Court against the Election Commission of India's freeze on the Trinamool Congress symbol. The plea argues that the ECI relied on statements of rebel legislators subject to disqualification under the Tenth Schedule (anti-defection law).

items.title: Inaugural Carpathian Eight Regional Summit Hosted in Ukraine
items.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy hosted the inaugural summit of the 'Carpathian Eight' regional grouping. The summit brought together leaders from Ukraine, Romania, Serbia, Poland, Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Austria, and Hungary, along with involvement from the European Union.

items.title: India and Bhutan Review Bilateral Development Cooperation
items.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met with his Bhutanese counterpart to discuss advancing multifaceted bilateral engagement. The two sides commended progress in development partnership, energy, trade, connectivity, culture, and people-to-people ties.

items.title: Denmark Inaugurates Greensand CO2 Storage Facility in North Sea

items.summary: The Bank of Japan has tightened monetary policy by raising interest rates to a 31-year high to battle inflation driven by rising oil prices from the West Asia crisis.

items.title: 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate Applied to UPI Transactions Above ₹2,000

items.title: NMDC Unveils Three-Phase Roadmap for Net Zero Operational Emissions by 2047

items.title: Net Direct Tax Collection Rises 13% to Over ₹12.12 Lakh Crore

items.summary: India's exports to core BRICS nations surged by 34% during April-August, with China leading the growth. The share of core BRICS countries in India's total exports increased to 9.2% from 8.1% during the first five months of the fiscal year.

items.title: Suchika Wins India's First-Ever Medal in MMA at 2026 Asian Games
items.summary: Suchika secured India's first-ever medal in Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) at the 2026 Asian Games. Additionally, India's men's 10m rifle team won a silver medal at the event.

items.title: Vidarsa Vinod Becomes First Woman Shooter from Keralam to Win Asian Games Medal
items.summary: Vidarsa Vinod became the first woman shooter from Keralam to win a medal at the Asian Games. She achieved this during her debut Asian Games, where she is also competing in the women's 50m rifle 3 Positions event.

items.title: Shafali Verma's Unbeaten Century Powers India to Asian Games 2026 Women's Cricket Final
items.summary: Shafali Verma scored an unbeaten 100 off 49 balls to fire India to 195 for four in the Asian Games 2026 second semifinal. Her performance secured India's spot in the women's cricket final and ensured a medal.

items.title: Vice-President to Inaugurate 9th India International Water Week
items.summary: The Vice-President of India is scheduled to inaugurate the 9th edition of India International Water Week.

items.title: 2026 Asian Games Hosted in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan
items.summary: The 2026 edition of the Asian Games is being hosted in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

items.title: First V4+India Foreign Ministers Meeting Held
items.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar highlighted the first V4+India Foreign Ministers meeting as a historic occasion. The Visegrad Group (V4) comprises the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, and Slovakia, aiming to advance cooperation in military, economic, cultural, and energy affairs.

items.title: Interim Trust Set Up to Run India-Built Cultural Centre in Jaffna
items.summary: An interim governing body has been established as a Trust to operationalise the India-built Cultural Centre in Jaffna. The move aims to provide administrative and financial autonomy for the facility's sustained operations.

items.title: RGCB Researchers Develop Nanopore Sensors for Parkinson’s Disease
items.summary: Researchers at the Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB) in Kerala have designed self-assembling dual-diameter nanopore sensors for the early detection of Parkinson's disease. The sensors are capable of detecting biomarkers associated with neurodegenerative diseases with high sensitivity.

items.title: Expansion of Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Breakfast Scheme Launched
items.summary: The Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Breakfast Scheme has been expanded to cover students in Classes VI to VIII across government and government-aided schools. The scheme expansion will benefit approximately 15.3 lakh students across 15,454 schools.

items.title: Six New Species Documented in Periyar Tiger Reserve Survey
items.summary: A four-day faunal survey conducted at the Periyar Tiger Reserve in Kerala recorded six species previously undocumented in the reserve. The discoveries include one bird, one butterfly, and four odonate species.

items.title: Transmission and Pathogen Facts of Scrub Typhus
items.summary: Scrub typhus is a bacterial infection caused by the bacterium Orientia tsutsugamushi. It is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected larval mites or chiggers and is not a mosquito-borne disease.

items.title: Supreme Court Rules Aadhaar Card Invalid as Proof to Determine Age
items.summary: The Supreme Court stated that an Aadhaar card is not a valid document for determining a person's age. A bench of Justices Sanjay Karol and Ujjal Bhuyan ruled that age must be determined from the date of birth mentioned in the school leaving certificate.

items.title: New Checklist Records 3,261 Flowering Plant Species in Agasthyamalai Biosphere Reserve
items.summary: A research team from the Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden and Research Institute compiled a new checklist recording 3,261 flowering plant species in the Agasthyamalai Biosphere Reserve. The study reaffirms the global significance of the Western Ghats as a major biodiversity hotspot.

items.title: Suchika Tariyal Wins India's Maiden Asian Games Medal in Mixed Martial Arts
items.summary: Suchika Tariyal won a bronze medal in mixed martial arts at the 20th edition of the Asian Games 2026. This marked India's maiden medal in the discipline, which made its debut at the Games.
